concepts.proposed_markdown: For local communications, the merchant POS sends Terminal API requests over the LAN to an Adyen terminal, which routes shopper-completed transactions to Adyen and returns a synchronous response. Live local processing requires terminal-certificate validation against Adyen's root and shared-key protection between POS and terminal; the guide describes test as unenforced while building. Missing or timed-out payment responses call for a transaction-status check before operators risk a duplicate transaction. This website architecture guide is separate from the exact-commit Postman examples and independently versioned SDK implementations.
warnings: The website guide's older library-version examples do not update or supersede the separately versioned GitHub SDK baseline.
